violations.issue: File imports @playwright/test directly instead of persistent-context. This bypasses auth handling and loses login state sharing across tests.
Hardcoded URLs appear in 10+ tests instead of using resolveComponentUrl('feature-banner'). This is fragile to style-guide URL changes.
violations.fix: Use resolveComponentUrl('feature-banner') from content-fixture-deployer in POM.navigate() or create a BASE_URL constant in the spec file that calls resolveComponentUrl().

violations.fix: Create a POM class with navigate() using resolveComponentUrl() or add URL resolution helper in beforeEach or top-level test setup.

violations.issue: POM methods getRoot() and getFooterTop() are called before loginToAEMAuthor() guarantees completion in beforeEach (line 10). The test calls page.goto() in pom.navigate() which may race with auth cookies not yet available.
violations.fix: Ensure loginToAEMAuthor() awaits fully in beforeEach and verify auth state is set before any page.goto(). Consider adding explicit auth check in POM.navigate().

violations.issue: ConsoleCapture is created and used but the errors array is never attached to the test report via attachConsoleCapture(). Console errors are captured but not visible in CI/test logs.
violations.fix: Add: attachConsoleCapture(errors) before expect() or within the test result annotation step.

violations.issue: ConsoleCapture is captured but never attached to the test report. Filtered errors are asserted but not visible in CI/logs.
violations.fix: Add: attachConsoleCapture(unexpected) before or alongside expect() to make console output visible in the test report.

violations.issue: Raw page.click() / locator.click() used instead of wrapper from action-utils. No retry logic or error context for flaky clicks on mobile.
violations.fix: Import and use clickElement() from src/utils/action-utils for consistent click handling and retry logic.

violations.issue: Raw expect() assertions used instead of assert-utils patterns. No custom error messages or assertion context for failed assertions.
violations.fix: Import and use assertion helpers from src/utils/assert-utils for better error reporting and consistency.

violations.issue: page.waitForTimeout() called 11+ times with hardcoded durations (200ms, 300ms, 500ms, 1000ms). Inconsistent pattern for waiting on animations/transitions.
violations.fix: Create a constant (TRANSITION_DELAY = 500) and use page.waitForLoadState() or locator-based waits instead: await locator.waitFor({ state: 'visible' }).

violations.issue: loginToAEMAuthor() in beforeEach does not prevent early page.goto() calls if pom.navigate() is called synchronously. No guarantee auth is complete.
violations.fix: Ensure POM.navigate() checks and waits for auth state to be available before calling page.goto().

roadmap.description: Migrate feature-banner.author.spec.ts and form-field-text.author.spec.ts from @playwright/test to persistent-context
Add attachConsoleCapture() calls to navigation.author.spec.ts and accordion.author.spec.ts to attach captured errors to test reports
Fix auth race conditions in footer.author.spec.ts, tabs.author.spec.ts, and teaser-card.author.spec.ts by ensuring POM.navigate() waits for auth state
Replace 41+ hardcoded component URLs in feature-banner.author.spec.ts (10) and form-field-text.author.spec.ts (31) with resolveComponentUrl()
Replace raw click() calls in navigation.author.spec.ts (8 instances) with clickElement() from action-utils
Replace raw expect() assertions in statistic.author.spec.ts (10+ instances) with assert-utils patterns
Replace 11+ page.waitForTimeout() calls in accordion.author.spec.ts with constants and locator-based waits

sampleFixes.explanation: persistent-context provides shared auth state across tests, ensuring login happens once per worker and cookies are reused. @playwright/test creates isolated contexts with no auth sharing.

sampleFixes.violation: CRITICAL: ConsoleCapture is captured but never attached to test report (lines 511-545)
sampleFixes.explanation: attachConsoleCapture(errors) makes the console output visible in the test report and CI logs. Without it, errors are captured silently and not visible to developers debugging test failures.

sampleFixes.violation: MEDIUM: page.waitForTimeout() hardcoded across 11+ lines instead of using constants
sampleFixes.explanation: Named constants make timeout durations discoverable and editable in one place. If CSS transitions change, developers can update TRANSITION_DELAY once instead of hunting through 11+ lines. Also documents why each delay exists.

sampleFixes.violation: HIGH: Hardcoded URLs in 31+ tests instead of using resolveComponentUrl()
sampleFixes.explanation: resolveComponentUrl() handles style-guide URL resolution dynamically. If the style-guide structure changes, tests still work. Hardcoded URLs break when the style-guide is reorganized (common during component development).

keyFindings: 6 CRITICAL violations block proper test execution: 2 files using wrong import (auth lost), 2 files with unattached console capture (errors invisible), 3 files with auth race conditions (flaky tests)
41+ hardcoded component URLs in 2 files reduce maintainability; style-guide reorganization will break 31 tests in form-field-text.author.spec.ts alone
11+ page.waitForTimeout() calls in accordion.author.spec.ts lack documentation; hardcoded durations become stale when CSS transitions change
8 raw click() calls in navigation.author.spec.ts bypass retry logic; flaky mobile clicks will fail without action-utils wrapper
10+ raw expect() assertions in statistic.author.spec.ts lack custom error context; test failures are hard to debug without assertion-utils patterns
Consistent issue across footer, tabs, teaser-card: loginToAEMAuthor() in beforeEach does not prevent early page.goto() in POM; auth state is not guaranteed before navigation
